    FDA status checked 19 Oct 2026

    The growth hormone peptides sold for muscle are research-use products with no approved version; we show their prices and checks and do not link to the shops.

    FDA status of the peptides on this page, each with its source.

    PeptideStatusWhat that means
    CJC-1295Not approvedits nomination for pharmacy compounding was withdrawn FDA source, 19 Oct 2026
    IpamorelinNot approvedon the FDA list of substances that may be unsafe to compound FDA source, 19 Oct 2026
    SermorelinNot approvedno FDA-approved product is on the market; the approved brand was taken off the market years ago 1
    Tesamorelin (Egrifta)FDA approvedan FDA-approved product exists FDA source, 19 Oct 2026

    Approved means the FDA approved a product containing it for a stated use. Not approved means no approved product exists; buying it for yourself is not a crime in the US, but nobody has checked what is in the vial. All substances

    Questions about peptides for muscle growth

    What are the best peptides for muscle growth?

    No peptide is FDA approved for building muscle. The options on this page: Tesamorelin (Egrifta), daily shot for belly fat in HIV; Sermorelin, pharmacy-made growth-hormone shot; CJC-1295 / ipamorelin, vials sold for growth hormone.

    Are peptides for muscle growth FDA approved?

    FDA approved: Tesamorelin (Egrifta). No FDA-approved product on the market: Sermorelin. Not approved: CJC-1295 / ipamorelin. Each status has its source under "Is it legal today?".

    How much do peptides for muscle growth cost?

    Sermorelin: from $1.84/mg at 10 shops. CJC-1295 / ipamorelin: from $0.099/mg at 15 shops. Prices checked 8 Nov 2026.

    Do I need a prescription for peptides for muscle growth?

    On prescription: Tesamorelin (Egrifta) and Sermorelin. Research use only: CJC-1295 / ipamorelin.
